name: Kimpton Santo
positioning: Hotel in San Antonio (official name Kimpton Santo San Antonio - Riverwalk) that combines a new building with a restored 1850s schoolhouse, between downtown and Southtown
best_for: Travelers who want a base between downtown and Southtown
Guests who like a rooftop pool and rooftop bar
Travelers bringing pets of any kind

facts.text: The hotel combines a new-build building with a restored 1850s German-English schoolhouse.
The hotel sits between downtown San Antonio and the Southtown neighborhood.
The schoolhouse suites overlook a historic courtyard with century-old live oaks.
The Hemisfair suites are in the east wing and have floor to ceiling windows with views of the Hemisfair District.
The Study is a cocktail lounge in one of the original 19th-century schoolhouses, with indoor and outdoor seating, cocktails and small plates.
Tenfold Rooftop Bar serves cocktails focused on tequila and mezcal, plus beer and wine by the glass.
The pool deck has views of the city skyline and the hotel's historic courtyard.
Hemisfair Park, once the grounds of the 1968 World's Fair, has been revitalized into a downtown community with homes, local businesses and public parks.
The San Antonio Riverwalk is an easy walk from the hotel.
The hotel accepts all pets with no restrictions on pet type, size, breed or quantity.

highlights.text: The hotel has one outdoor rooftop pool, which is heated and has private cabanas.
Dean's Steak & Seafood is a steakhouse and oyster bar inside the 19th-century schoolhouse.
Tenfold is an open-air rooftop bar that operates year-round.
The Hemisfair suites are in the east wing and have floor to ceiling windows with views of the Hemisfair District.
Kimpton Santo is San Antonio's first Kimpton hotel.

considerations.text: There is no local area shuttle and no airport shuttle at the hotel.
WhataHotel notes an urban setting with potential street noise.
